title: ROADMAP DEBT PAYMENT PILOT
description: The update treats combat feel and monetization pressure as one shared pacing problem. Three long-promised fixes ship with direct patch notes, no event wrapper, and no commemorative bundle. The upgrade flow now presents higher-value bundles at the exact moment players run out of patience.
consequence: Players reacted with suspicion to a promise being kept in daylight. The economy found the pause between frustration and quitting.

title: ROADMAP DEBT PAYMENT RELIEF
description: The feature moves a player-facing convenience into the same room as a business goal. Three long-promised fixes ship with direct patch notes, no event wrapper, and no commemorative bundle. Several paid shortcuts have been moved into baseline progression to reduce accusations of hostage design.
consequence: Players reacted with suspicion to a promise being kept in daylight. Revenue meetings became quieter in the way elevators get quiet.

title: ASPIRATIONAL ROADMAP REFRESH PILOT
description: The update makes the game easier to explain from the outside, with consequences for those still inside. Previously announced features have been reframed as directional pillars while the team evaluates delivery confidence. The upgrade flow now presents higher-value bundles at the exact moment players run out of patience.
consequence: The roadmap survived by becoming less related to roads. The economy found the pause between frustration and quitting.
